fig_ccap_plan_object: CECAP plan object. The compiler emits not only code but a contract-and-evidence-carrying plan containing graph, backend, layout, precision, schedule, memory, dependencies, fallback, applicability domain, and evidence.
fig_ccap_hierarchical_search: Contract-constrained hierarchical search. CECAP filters illegal plans using hardware contracts before propagating Pareto candidates through graph, algorithm, TensorIR, and hardware-mapping levels.
fig_ccap_evidence_ladder: Proof-carrying compilation evidence ladder. The current prototype reaches static, compile, host-diff, and virtual RTOS evidence, while board and stress/performance evidence remain unfilled.
